passages.text: This is the word that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch son of Neriah when he wrote these words on a scroll at the dictation of Jeremiah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says to you, Baruch: You have said, ‘Woe is me because the LORD has added sorrow to my pain! I am worn out with groaning and have found no rest.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet.
Baruch was the son of Neriah.
Jeremiah spoke a message to Baruch.
Baruch wrote these words on a scroll.
Jeremiah dictated the words to Baruch.
This happened in the fourth year of Jehoiakim.
Jehoiakim was the son of Josiah.
Jehoiakim was king of Judah.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD spoke to Baruch.
The LORD said this to Baruch.
Baruch, you have said, “Woe is me.”
You said, “The LORD has added sorrow to my pain.”
You said, “I am worn out with groaning.”
You said, “I have found no rest.”
passages.original: הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבֶּר֙ יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֔יא אֶל־ בָּר֖וּךְ בֶּֽן־ נֵֽרִיָּ֑ה בְּכָתְבוֹ֩ אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֨ים הָאֵ֤לֶּה עַל־ סֵ֙פֶר֙ מִפִּ֣י יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ בַּשָּׁנָה֙ הָֽרְבִעִ֔ית לִיהוֹיָקִ֧ים בֶּן־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֛הוּ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃ס כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עָלֶ֖יךָ בָּרֽוּךְ׃ אָמַ֙רְתָּ֙ אֽוֹי־ נָ֣א לִ֔י כִּֽי־ יָסַ֧ף יְהוָ֛ה יָג֖וֹן עַל־ מַכְאֹבִ֑י יָגַ֙עְתִּי֙ בְּאַנְחָתִ֔י וּמְנוּחָ֖ה לֹ֥א מָצָֽאתִי׃ס

passages.text: Thus Jeremiah was to say to Baruch: “This is what the LORD says: Throughout the land I will demolish what I have built and uproot what I have planted.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of the LORD.
Baruch was the son of Neriah.
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah.
The LORD gave Jeremiah a message for Baruch.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD said this:
I will destroy what I have built.
I will pull up what I have planted.
I will do this throughout the whole land.
passages.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ תֹּאמַ֣ר אֵלָ֗יו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנֵּ֤ה אֲשֶׁר־ בָּנִ֙יתִי֙ אֲנִ֣י הֹרֵ֔ס וְאֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ נָטַ֖עְתִּי אֲנִ֣י נֹתֵ֑שׁ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ הִֽיא׃

passages.text: But as for you, do you seek great things for yourself? Stop seeking! For I will bring disaster on every living creature, declares the LORD, but wherever you go, I will grant your life as a spoil of war.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Baruch, son of Neriah, through Jeremiah the prophet.
Baruch, do not seek great things for yourself.
Stop seeking them.
I, the LORD, will bring disaster on every living creature.
But I will give you your life wherever you go.
Your life will be your reward, like a spoil of war.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֛ה תְּבַקֶּשׁ־ לְךָ֥ גְדֹל֖וֹת אַל־ תְּבַקֵּ֑שׁ כִּ֡י הִנְנִי֩ מֵבִ֨יא רָעָ֤ה עַל־ כָּל־ בָּשָׂר֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְנָתַתִּ֨י לְךָ֤ אֶֽת־ נַפְשְׁךָ֙ לְשָׁלָ֔ל עַ֥ל כָּל־ הַמְּקֹמ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר תֵּֽלֶךְ־ שָֽׁם׃ס
